messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — engagement letter
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Anders,

Following our call, I attach our engagement letter for the proposed licensing of the HX-7 technology to Northstar. It sets out our scope, the team (myself, James Osei and Elena Marchetti), and our fee estimate of £55,000–£75,000 plus VAT.

If you are happy, please sign and return the copy and we'll get started on the NDA straight away.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1200
